conf.description: AWS GuardDuty findings-s3-export / json: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: aws-guardduty / findings-s3-export / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (AWS integration - GuardDuty (aws.guardduty data stream, aws-s3 input)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
